TD-CS-031-001.name: Valid Vendor Change Request — Approve with Audit Report Attachment
TD-CS-031-001.expectedOutcome: Change request approved; vendor manufacturing site updated; PO creation unblocked; audit trail logged

TD-CS-031-NEG-001.name: Reject Vendor Change Request — Verify Automatic Rollback
TD-CS-031-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: Change request rejected; vendor manufacturing site reverts to original value; audit trail logged with rejection

TD-CS-031-NEG-002.name: Attempt PO Creation Against Vendor with Pending Change Request
TD-CS-031-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: SAP blocks PO creation; error message displayed indicating pending vendor change request; no PO created

TD-CS-031-ERR-001.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Approval Decision
TD-CS-031-ERR-001.note: emptyDecision intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-031-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Decision field as mandatory; prevents submission; change request remains pending

TD-CS-031-ERR-002.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Vendor ID
TD-CS-031-ERR-002.note: emptyVendorId intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-031-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Vendor ID field as mandatory; prevents submission; change request remains pending or error state

TD-CS-031-EDGE-001.name: Maximum Length Approval Comments — 255 Characters
TD-CS-031-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Change request approved; all 255 characters stored and displayed correctly; no truncation

TD-CS-031-EDGE-002.name: Maximum Size Attachment Upload — 10 MB
TD-CS-031-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Change request approved; 10 MB file uploaded and stored successfully; file retrievable

TD-CS-031-EDGE-003.name: No Attachment Provided — Optional Field
TD-CS-031-EDGE-003.note: noAttachment is null — no file attached, testing optional field behavior
TD-CS-031-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Change request approved without attachment; no error; audit trail logged
